notes: Updated for Roblox 0.745.0.7451137, with every address re-derived from a fresh dump of that exact client.
Fixed game detection: the DataModel place id offset was 8 bytes off, so the executor sat at the menu waiting for a game that was already running and scripts never executed.
The release gate now handles the load-clock check Roblox removed in 0.740 instead of failing on a check that cannot fire.
Requires Roblox 0.745.0.7451137. If you are on a different build, re-run the install script — it pins the right one.
